events.title: Sea Witch Festival returns
events.description: Rehoboth's costume parade, pet costume contest and boardwalk crowds mark the unofficial end of the season. It's on the calendar early because it sells out hotels early, too.

events.title: Historic Lewes Farmers Market
events.description: Produce, flowers and baked goods on the Zwaanendael lawn every Saturday morning through late September — the best excuse to get up early on vacation.
events.venue: George H.P. Smith Park, Johnson & Dupont Aves.
events.sourceOrg: Lewes Chamber of Commerce / Historic Lewes Farmers Market
events.editorialNote: Recurring weekly market, not a single-date event.

events.title: ZAP Pro/Am World Championships of Skimboarding
events.description: The long-running skimboarding championship draws riders from well beyond Delaware. Exact beach location is set closer to the date based on sand and surf conditions — check the source before heading out.
events.venue: Dewey Beach (exact location TBA based on conditions)
events.editorialNote: Beach venue TBA — confirm the exact location close to the date.

events.title: US Navy Band Sea Chanters at the Bandstand
events.description: The Navy's official chorus takes the Rehoboth Bandstand for one night — a genuinely different kind of free summer show than the usual tribute act lineup.
events.editorialNote: Performers subject to change; the city notes the show can be cancelled for weather.

events.title: The Brit Pack — British Invasion & More
events.description: British Invasion covers close out this stretch of the Rehoboth Bandstand's summer series on a Sunday night.
events.editorialNote: Performers subject to change; the city notes the show can be cancelled for weather.
